highlights.title: Accessibility and VoiceOver improvements
changes: VoiceOver now speaks status, charts, and icon-only buttons in plain words.
Controls that previously required gestures can now be activated with VoiceOver actions.
Glucose bobble and charts now read a single, combined summary with value, trend, delta, and age.
Text scaling is bounded to prevent very large fonts from breaking layouts.
Glass panels and small UI chrome switch to opaque, higher-contrast fills when Reduce Transparency or Increase Contrast.

includedPullRequests.title: Introduce Accessibility Improvements
includedPullRequests.body:
## Summary

This PR introduces broad accessibility improvements  across the entire app, focused on VoiceOver support, Dynamic Type limits, and Reduce Transparency / Increase Contrast fallbacks. The goal throughout is to make status, controls, and charts that currently rely on color, icons, or gestures readable and operable for assistive-technology users.

The main areas covered:

- **Status readouts spoken in words** — loop pill, pump reservoir/battery/pod, IOB/COB, alarms, eventual glucose, and Nightscout/Tidepool connection state now announce their meaning instead of color and icon names. The glucose bobble reads value, range, trend, delta, age, and sensor warmup/expiry as one element.
- **Controls made operable via VoiceOver** — slide-to-confirm quick bolus (previously drag-only, which blocked delivery), stop-adjustment / stop-temp-target / stop-override cancels, tappable header panels, and picker rows across settings, onboarding, statistics, alarms, and therapy editors.
- **Grouped, labeled content** — recommendation-math cards, bolus-progress readouts, stat summaries, and settings value rows read as single coherent phrases; icon-only buttons (help, hint, add/remove, dismiss, time nudge, etc.) get spoken labels; decorative icons and row dots are hidden.
- **Charts named** — glucose, forecast, basal, carb-ratio, ISF, target, calibration, and the twelve statistics charts get VoiceOver labels.
- **Dynamic Type bounded app-wide** — capped at accessibility1 globally (tighter at xxLarge on the dense Statistics screen) so large text scales without breaking layouts.
- **Glass chrome fallbacks** — glass panels and small material affordances fall back to an opaque, higher-contrast fill under Reduce Transparency or Increase Contrast.

## Additional notes

This PR depends on #1332 and should not be merged until that lands.
Addresses #1351. 

## Reviewing

This is a rather large PR (**16 commits, 85 files**), but each commit is self-contained and scoped to a specific area or screen. **Please review commit-by-commit** rather than viewing the full diff. That keeps each change in context and makes the scope far easier to follow.
